description: Nick's decision to remain in Knights Ridge forces the group to live with the consequences of secrets exposed at the end of the first season. Owen tries to recover from Alison and Ikey's betrayal, Hannah's future with Ray becomes increasingly uncertain, Nick and Aubrey struggle with unfinished family business, and the friendships at the center of town are tested before a later epilogue finally closes the road.

s02e01.description: Nick and Eddie head to New York to find Owen after the revelation of Alison and Ikey's affair, while Hannah is forced to confront how strongly Nick's return has changed what she wants.

s02e02.description: Hannah tells Nick how she feels, Nick worries that another professor may be pursuing Aubrey, and Eddie continues pretending his relationship with Janet is less serious than it has become.

s02e03.description: Owen sends Nick on an uncomfortable fact-finding mission about Alison's affair with Ikey, while Eddie weighs revealing a secret that could destroy a business partnership and Sam pushes back against Hannah's wedding plans.

s02e04.description: Holiday arrangements force Owen and Alison to divide time with their children, Phil invents an impressive career for visiting parents, Janet's heartfelt gift unsettles Eddie, and Nick uncovers a secret about his late mother.

s02e05.description: Hannah clashes with Ray's former wife over the boys, Nick arranges a double date for Ronnie, and Pizza Girl challenges Phil to take his treasured car out into the world instead of merely protecting it.

s02e06.description: A superhero comic Nick created as a teenager resurfaces at the worst possible moment while he and Eddie pursue a new project, and Hannah and Janet attempt a double date with the men in their lives.

s02e07.description: Nick suspects Aubrey may be seeing someone else, Ray presses ahead with plans to adopt Sam, Janet wants more intimacy from Eddie, and the annual spelling bee turns private tensions into very public competition.

s02e08.description: Nick learns Aubrey has reconnected with her estranged father, Ray increases the pressure over adopting Sam, Owen and Alison begin dating other people, and the Commander receives troubling medical news.

s02e09.description: Nick tries to persuade Aubrey's fugitive father to explain himself to her, while the group takes a road trip to find the woman whose quick action once saved Owen's life.

s02e10.description: Nick discovers that his finances are in serious trouble as Hannah's mother arrives before the wedding, while Owen begins seeing the beer-delivery driver who saved him and several relationships reach decision points.

s02e11.description: The death of their childhood crush Angela sends the men back through memories of being ten years old, forcing them to compare who they imagined becoming with the lives they actually built.

s02e12.description: Eddie's former girlfriend returns to Knights Ridge determined to revive their relationship, putting Janet on alert as old attachments surface at exactly the wrong time.

s02e13.description: Hannah's arrest threatens her engagement to Ray, Nick receives a career offer that would take him away from Knights Ridge and his ill father, and an earlier betrayal erupts into a confrontation that leaves several futures unresolved.

s02e14.description: Beginning around Hannah's wedding and then jumping seven years forward, the DVD epilogue revisits the group as Sam prepares for his own road trip and finally resolves the central questions surrounding his father and Nick and Hannah's relationship.
